decisions.reason: Changing the fiat on-ramp provider from Stripe to Coinbase Commerce does not alter secondary-sale royalty enforcement, pool destinations, or ticket generation.
The source changes only the fiat on-ramp provider; Brevo remains the transactional email provider.
Replacing Stripe with Coinbase Commerce for fiat on-ramping does not change email magic-link authentication or its dashboard-access purpose.
The provider switch does not change the reward allocation applied when a primary mint uses no referral code.
The fiat on-ramp provider choice does not alter ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, or post-draw resets.
The payment-provider change does not affect random prize selection, ticket weighting, or winner eligibility.
The fiat on-ramp provider switch leaves the Small Block prize amounts, pool trigger, and royalty contribution rules unchanged.
